_about: Canonical source registry: WHERE metaharness looks for the best agent tools. Single source of truth for BOTH the daily scanner (research_update.py) and the public site (build_site.py), so every backend change surfaces on the site automatically. method=github/hackernews/mcp-registry/npm sources are swept live by the scanner; method=reference/community are curated sources reported with their logo (and, for community, pulled at compose-time via agent-reach). Cross-source corroboration — a tool surfacing in more than one source — is the ranking signal no other directory computes.

sources.name: GitHub
sources.contributes: Every skill, MCP server, agent pack and harness ships as a repo. We sweep topics, full-text search, and star velocity — the raw material of the index.

sources.name: Hacker News
sources.contributes: The front-page signal: which agent tools practitioners are actually discussing this week, ranked by points. Catches launches before they trend on GitHub.

sources.name: MCP Registry
sources.contributes: The official Model Context Protocol registry: newly published MCP servers straight from the canonical source, before third-party directories mirror them.

sources.name: npm
sources.contributes: Most skills and MCP servers ship as npm packages; weekly download counts are a hard usage signal that stars cannot fake.

sources.name: skills.sh
sources.contributes: The agent-skills directory with real install-count leaderboards, refreshed daily. Popularity signal we rate on top of — installs measure marketing, our score measures outcomes.

sources.name: Glama
sources.contributes: One of the largest MCP server directories (20k+ servers) with quality and security metadata — a breadth net for the MCP lane.

sources.name: PulseMCP
sources.contributes: MCP server directory with a weekly newsletter tracking what is new and active — freshness on the MCP lane.

sources.name: Smithery
sources.contributes: Curated MCP and workflow directory with one-command install and usage stats — vetted end-to-end automations.

sources.name: Product Hunt
sources.contributes: Where new AI dev tools launch and get their first upvote signal — catches commercial entrants the GitHub sweep misses.

sources.name: Anthropic
sources.contributes: The platform's own skills (frontend-design, pptx, pdf, docx) and plugin marketplaces — highest-trust, lowest-noise, tracked first.

sources.name: Awesome Lists
sources.contributes: Hand-vetted awesome-lists (awesome-claude-code, awesome-agent-skills) are the slow-but-trusted human filter we cross-check the automated sweep against.

sources.name: Reddit
sources.contributes: r/ClaudeAI, r/ClaudeCode and r/mcp — where practitioners say what actually works and what quietly broke. Pulled at compose-time via agent-reach (Reddit blocks datacenter scraping).

sources.name: X
sources.contributes: The practitioner threads where the winning stack COMBINATIONS surface first. Pulled at compose-time via agent-reach.
